title: draba pauciflora var. subcapitata
intro: Draba pauciflora var. subcapitata, commonly known as Alpine Whitlowgrass or Alpine Whitlow Grass, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family, characterized by its small, white flowers and compact growth habit. The plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate respiratory issues and wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Draba pauciflora var. subcapitata are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit microbial growth, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in various studies as contributing to its medicinal properties.
